<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="dhTei78DZyLTjWWdzUyG"> <mxGraphModel dx="3930" dy="3485" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph User [\"User\"]
 U_Interact[\"Set age, height, contract, position, foot, goals/assists per match, matches played\"]
 U_Click[\"Click PREDICT VALUE\"]
 U_View[\"View predicted value\"]
 U_Decision{\"Try another player?\"}
 end

 subgraph App [\"Streamlit app (app.py)\"]
 Start(( )) --> A_Config[\"Configure page, render title\"]
 A_Config --> A_Load[\"load_model() — cached with @st.cache_resource\"]
 A_Load --> D_ModelExists{\"model.json exists?\"}
 D_ModelExists -->|no| A_Error[\"Show error & stop (st.error + st.stop)\"] --> End1(( ))
 D_ModelExists -->|yes| A_Render[\"Render sliders & dropdowns\"]
 A_Render --> U_Interact
 U_Interact --> U_Click
 U_Click --> A_Build[\"build_input(): numeric features + one-hot position & foot → 1-row DataFrame\"]
 A_Build --> A_Wrap[\"Wrap in xgb.DMatrix\"]
 A_Wrap --> A_Predict
 A_Clip[\"Clip negatives to 0; range = value ± 22%\"] --> A_Tier[\"tier_label(): Emerging → World class\"]
 A_Tier --> A_Display[\"Render value, tier badge, gauge & feature bar (Plotly)\"]
 A_Display --> U_View
 U_View --> U_Decision
 U_Decision -->|yes| A_Render
 U_Decision -->|no| End2(( ))
 end

 subgraph Model [\"XGBoost model\"]
 M_Load[\"Load Booster from model.json\"]
 A_Wrap -.-> M_Predict[\"Booster.predict()\"]
 M_Predict --> A_Clip
 end

 D_ModelExists -->|yes| M_Load
 M_Load --> A_Render

 Note1[\"Streamlit reruns app.py top-to-bottom on every widget change. @st.cache_resource keeps the model loaded, so it is not reloaded each time.\"]
